response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.72. It is a proposal only, awaiting a human decision (case C-A-261019-0002).

**Three facts that drove it:**
1. T-X1019-01 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. It quoted a SELL 4225 / BUY 845 pair about every 3 seconds, cancelled both together, and re-priced with the touch from 10002 down to 9994. Both sizes are at or below the 4225 typical order size.
2. The SELL side was trading. 3939 filled before the only opposite-side fill, a BUY of 146 at 9995, and 12063 filled in total. Under the closure standard the resting order was working, so feature (a) is absent.
3. The price fell 5 ticks and did not revert (reversion 0). There was no repetition of the cycle in the session and no market event. The 5-tick fall with no reversion is not a benefit, so feature (b) is absent.

**What would change my mind:** The weak point is the 5:1 SELL/BUY size skew (cancel symmetry 0.36). I would escalate if a longer frame showed the skew was not inventory-driven. That would mean SELL quotes placed ahead of BUY fills at one-sided scale, or the 5-tick fall reverting later.
